title: Október 23.: 1956 forradalma és a Köztársaság (October 23rd: 1956 Revolution & Republic)
grammar: Commemorative Syntax, State Protocol & Solemn Historical Memorialization

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what happened on 23 October 1956 and on 23 October 1989.
I can explain why October 23 is a double anniversary.
I can use megemlékezik with -ról/-ről to talk about two anniversaries.
I can read a short text about October 23 and answer questions about it.
